C54.justification: The plan was frozen at 2026-09-29T02:51:56.296212Z after the verbatim reference result, before any compact-reference responses. It permits one version only. The rendering changes ordering, imperative wording, and level of detector detail, so it is not a pure length-only ablation and cannot assess preference inference from edits. The same test set is reused.

C55.justification: The editor system prompt includes RULES[A] and requests minimal sentence replacements preserving plot, meaning and required words. This is an instruction, not a verified semantic-preservation result. Two editing passes apply sentence references and then check public format; editor_valid records successful application and format. The new good() filter requires writer U and editor_valid only, without any style-improvement threshold. Private editor audit labels remain excluded from learner inputs. An additional offline attempt exactly matched 873 of 913 reconstructed call hashes and 444 of 460 final edit records. It did not reproduce 16 edit records under current segmentation, so this claim describes the archived configuration, not a complete reconstruction of archive creation. The original saved revisions are shared unchanged across learners. One investigated call differs only in surrounding sentence whitespace; the remaining discrepancy causes are unresolved.

C56.justification: The retention analysis groups the three seed-specific binary strict-prompt outcomes by example ID, subtracts the single base outcome from the within-example mean, and resamples all 128 paired example differences with replacement for 10000 draws using seed 260928. The 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles form the interval. No writing-genre strata are used for this separate public benchmark. Independent recomputation matched both intervals.
